sources.finding: Exact Deny-Storage-http assignment references built-in 404c3081 with Deny effect and 2.*.* definition version. Placeholder scope is a library template, not deployed evidence.

Built-in 404c3081 version 2.0.0 checks explicit false and API-dependent absent values. Audit/Deny/Disabled effect and missing-property defaults differ from LandingLens's explicit-boolean-only predicate; compliance remains a Signal, not an equivalent pass.
Azure.Storage.SecureTransfer / AZR-000196 accepts an omitted flag for API >=2019-04-01. This differs from LandingLens's explicit-property requirement; partial mapping only.

Azure.Storage.ContainerSoftDelete / AZR-000289 checks child enabled plus days>=1, with CloudShell/HNS/FileStorage exclusions. Its population and child/default semantics are not equivalent to the whole checklist or LandingLens predicate.
Actual rule guidance links built-in 404c3081 and documents API-dependent secure-transfer defaults. These are associations, not operational encryption verification.
Frozen 255-GUID checklist supplies exact 49 nonempty query hashes and recommendation intent.

sources.finding: Reviewed static 49-query audit supplies per-GUID output/population limitations. No query was executed; query associations are related only, not an execution allowlist.

targets.rationale: Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Selects existing managed identities, omits combined identity type and service-principal consumers; cannot establish replacement or tenant usage.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Only exact subscription-scope role assignments join; no assignment ID, nested groups, inherited/RG roles or on-premises group management evidence.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. DC role inferred from name/tags. Any zone or availability set does not prove two DCs across zones, supported locations or resiliency.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Custom-role existence does not prove required business roles, permissions or team alignment; role definition ID is lost.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Replica-array count subset only. Missing arrays can disappear; complete replica inventory and intended multi-region applicability are required.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Hub classification is a name substring, not topology. Missing peerings or inaccessible remote networks cannot establish connectivity.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Arbitrary owner threshold >3; Azure RBAC Owner counts are not enrollment account ownership. Missing assignments do not prove zero owners.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Subscription ancestor-chain length only; root counting and complete visible hierarchy matter. Null/inaccessible chains cannot prove flatness.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Ancestor length >1 is a subscription-placement subset, not proof that all subscriptions are visible or root governance is appropriate.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Non-null tags can be empty or irrelevant; no billing keys/values or cost allocation intent is tested.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Prefix split has no explicit numeric/CIDR validation; <=27 differs from exact /27. Distinct parent IDs lose multiple subnet identities.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. 450 peerings differs from 400 spokes and 500 peering limit; not regional hub identification or ExpressRoute prefix population. Empty arrays vanish.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. <360 differs from recommendation limit 400. Expansion loses empty/omitted route tables; embedded routes must be complete.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Explicit peering flag subset; child canonical ID is not projected. Capitalized True syntax and returned types are not service-executed.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Frontend/private zones and public-IP joins require complete child/remote inventory; excludes Basic instead of failing it; regional support unknown.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Inline backend and NIC membership branches need complete inventories; unmatched/null NIC counts may disappear. Pool identity is not retained.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. RFC1918-looking string prefix is not validated CIDR/network containment; multiple prefixes require distinct evidence instances.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Mask >16 is not evidence that address space is appropriately allocated or not wasted; string/numeric conversion and intent are unverified.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Regional IP zone-array subset; does not establish Standard SKU, zone capability or global-IP applicability. No rows is not a pass.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Named Bastion subnet prefix subset; needs numeric CIDR validation, SKU applicability and canonical subnet IDs; missing subnets are not absent.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Excluding Basic/Standard is not bandwidth or performance sizing evidence; missing SKUs and workload requirements remain unknown.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Metered/local SKU is not a cost-justification test; actual bandwidth, contract and intended usage are missing.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Connection/circuit join needs full canonical identities and region eligibility. Any Local circuit does not justify every circuit's cost.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. AZ substring is not verified zone support; population also includes VPN although recommendation names ExpressRoute. Region applicability missing.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. SKU-name AZ substring does not establish regional zone availability or current capability; no default/capability inference is accepted.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Distinct circuit-location count requires complete connection/circuit joins; case-normalized IDs and missing locations need explicit validation.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Left-join null disableBgpRoutePropagation is treated as compliant: an inaccessible/missing route table can manufacture a pass. Not accepted.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. DNS proxy alone does not establish application rules, FQDN network rules or egress routing; compound recommendation cannot be reduced to this flag.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Explicit policy SKU only, not firewall association, runtime protection or whether Premium is required for this workload.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Reimplement typed local Deny flag with explicit Standard/Premium tier. Basic cannot deny. Missing enums/SKU are unknown, not provider defaults.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Reimplement typed local IDPS Deny flag on explicit Premium tier only; not effective inherited mode, bypass/signature coverage or runtime IDPS.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. A route-table reference is not an Internet route to a firewall/NVA; Virtual WAN peering inferred from names. Missing joins are unsafe.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Exact /26 subset needs numeric/CIDR validation and canonical subnet ID; omitted arrays and subnet applicability remain unknown.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Query filters to attached policies and compares a Boolean with string true. Existing accepted typed predicate is separate, not this query.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Non-VWAN firewall zone-array subset; managed/regional zone support and SKU/availability applicability need review. No rows cannot prove resilience.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Firewall/VNet/DDoS plan joins need complete child IDs; orphan right rows can lack firewall identity. Association is not runtime mitigation.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Null serviceEndpoints becomes compliant; missing details can manufacture a pass. Exceptions and full subnet inventory require review.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Gateway subnet <=27 requires numeric/CIDR and canonical child checks; missing or inapplicable gateway subnets cannot be inferred absent.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Any blanket deny ignores priority, preceding allows, service-tag semantics and effective NSG rules; not an effective inbound-policy proof.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. NSG-reference presence subset only; requires canonical child identities, explicit special-subnet applicability and effective-policy caveats.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Flow-log join tests existence but does not require the projected Traffic Analytics flag to be true. Inaccessible flow logs cannot prove absence.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. <900 disagrees with no more than 900 at the boundary; complete custom rule arrays and separate system/effective rules require review.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Virtual-hub firewall reference subset; existence does not prove secured outbound routing or effective filtering.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Boolean property compared with string true; coercion is not accepted. Explicit approved branch-blocking intent can change applicability.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Explicit routing-preference enum subset; defaults, operational routing and regional/product applicability are not inferred.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Mask <23 incorrectly excludes /23 versus at least /23; subnet text parsing is not CIDR validation. No corrected automation is accepted here.
Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. LRS SKU matches only; missing/unsupported SKUs and resiliency intent cannot become passes from an empty violation list.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Vault count !=1 makes zero vaults compliant; does not distinguish apps, environments or regions. Not an acceptable segregation predicate.

Static candidate only; not an executable allowlist or outcome. Inner-joined SecurityInsights solution existence excludes unmatched workspaces and does not prove SIEM ingestion, correlation or operations.
